title: New on AppSumo This Week: Fresh deals for sales, demos, and funnels
subtitle: A quick look at five new software deals for solopreneurs and small teams
html:
Disclosure: this post contains affiliate links. If you buy through them, I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.

Too many monthly subscriptions eat into budgets, and teams need tools that fit lean workflows.

This week’s new AppSumo picks cover interactive sales collateral, personalized videos, no-code funnels, collaborative meetings, and product demos—aimed at accelerating your outreach and onboarding.

Storydoc — interactive slides for sales collateral

Storydoc lets you create sales and marketing collateral in an interactive slide format. It focuses on producing slides that engage prospects through interactive elements.

This can help teams deliver more compelling pitches and assets without needing separate design or development work.

See the Storydoc deal on AppSumo

Hippo Video — personalized B2B videos for engagement

Hippo Video enables creating, sharing, and tracking personalized B2B videos to optimize sales engagement.

Users can measure how recipients interact with videos to inform follow-ups and outreach strategies.

See the Hippo Video deal on AppSumo

MarbleFlows — no-code funnels and forms for growth

MarbleFlows provides no-code tools to build funnels, forms, and popups for lead generation and user onboarding.

This can help teams create and adjust lead capture and onboarding experiences without custom development.

See the MarbleFlows deal on AppSumo

Dive — collaborative agendas, notes, and action items

Dive makes online meetings easier with features for collaborative agendas, notes, and action items.

The focus is on keeping meetings productive by organizing discussions and next steps in one place.

See the Dive deal on AppSumo

Komodo Decks — interactive screen casting for demos

Komodo Decks offers interactive screen casting to support product demos, walkthroughs, and more.

It’s aimed at helping teams present software workflows with engaging, shareable content.

See the Komodo Decks deal on AppSumo

How to choose

When choosing, consider how each tool fits your current sales, onboarding, and meeting workflows, and whether the learning curve aligns with your team size.

Always read the deal terms to understand limits, refunds, and any ongoing obligations before purchasing.

This article was written with AI assistance from the deal information AppSumo publishes. Check each deal page for current terms before you buy.
